'''April 2001 Greenwood tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Game Times, Greenwood, Indiana on 21 April 2001. [[Karl Harford]] won it. It is known from Eric Bailey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2125">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-22-greenwood-in-4-21-01d2125/ greenwood-in-4-21-01], DeckTech (Eric "YOYOY" Bailey, 22 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-22-greenwood-in-4-21-01d2125/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 21 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Game Times, Greenwood, Indiana
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[Karl Harford]]
